name: Two-part foldable hinge: motion + screen and cable keepouts
purpose: Two printable reference mating leaves rotate around an unverified 3mm hinge shaft without crushing hypothetical screens

requirements.statement: Two leaf bodies have interleaved coaxial knuckles and declared pin/bore running clearance.

verification.procedure: Reimport STEP and mechanically trial a real rod/print coupon

requirements.statement: Mating solids remain clear across all 0–180 degree positions.

verification.procedure: Independently evaluate BRep distances/intersections at discrete angles then test an actual assembled hinge

requirements.statement: Reference screen packages have noninterfering swept/closed space.

verification.procedure: Physically measure real display modules and test closed display-to-display clearance

requirements.statement: Reserve a service-loop envelope external to the hinge, without falsely claiming routed cable.

verification.procedure: Identify real cable/FPC and connector dimensions, route and fatigue-test external bend radius

requirements.statement: Folded CAD envelope meets declared thickness limit.

verification.procedure: Measure final assembled device and displays with calipers

requirements.statement: Two printed leaves export as valid mesh and STEP; metal shaft is reference-only.

verification.procedure: Use named FDM printer, measured shaft and print calibration coupons before physical assembly
